Stone Real Estate Seaforth presents an off-market development opportunity at 137A Woodland Street and 2 Nield Avenue, Balgowlah — a combined 1,934m² landholding under single ownership, zoned Low Medium Residential and positioned within an established residential enclave a short walk from Balgowlah village.

The site's natural topography rises from Woodland Street to Nield Avenue, unlocking harbour views from all upper-level apartments and enabling a tiered design response that maximises both outlook and amenity. The combination of site area, dual-street connectivity, and proximity to North Harbour Reserve positions this as one of the most compelling boutique development opportunities to come to market on the Northern Beaches.

A significant quantum of pre-development work has already been completed by the current owner — including planning, surveying, and engineering studies — reducing lead time and de-risking the entitlement phase for an incoming developer.

Single ownership across both lots eliminates amalgamation risk and provides a developer with clean, uncomplicated title over the full 1,934m².

The vendor is open to up to 15-month settlement with a 5% deposit, providing flexibility for DA approval and project financing to be progressed prior to completion.

The vendor may also consider remaining involved in a development management capacity for the right buyer, representing an opportunity to leverage existing site knowledge and completed studies.

Aerial overview — Subject site highlighted, 137A Woodland Street & 2 Nield Avenue, Balgowlah (1,934m²)

The Opportunity

Why This Site Stands Apart

Elevated Position with Harbour Views

The site naturally rises from Woodland Street through to Nield Avenue. This grade enables upper-level apartments to capture direct harbour views toward Sydney Harbour — a scarcity in this submarket that underpins premium end-sale pricing.

Ideal Product Mix

The topography supports a tiered/cascading apartment scheme: garden apartments with private courtyards at ground level, and harbour view apartments above. Efficient basement parking accessed via Woodland Street completes the scheme.

Boutique Scale — ~12 Apartments

At circa 1,934m², the site suits a boutique development of approximately 12 well-sized apartments — a scale that appeals to both owner-occupier and investor demand, and that limits competing supply on delivery.

Quiet Residential Street

Woodland Street is a low-traffic, tree-lined residential street — a meaningful distinction from main-road comparable sites and a material driver of buyer appetite and premium end pricing at the completion stage.

Significant Pre-Development Work Completed

The owner has completed planning, survey, and engineering work — including modelling of the basement driveway connecting both sites. DA-ready plans for a 5-unit scheme on 2 Nield Ave are being lodged in May 2026. A raw site sale maximises GFA and overall return.

Walk to Balgowlah Village & Transport

Within walking distance of Balgowlah's village retail, cafés, North Harbour Reserve, and bus connections to the CBD and Manly — a lifestyle amenity package that underpins demand across all unit typologies.

Upside Opportunity

Potential 30% Density Uplift via Affordable Housing Scheme

Under the NSW Affordable Housing provisions, eligible developments may qualify for up to a 30% increase in allowable height and density above the base LMR controls. For a site of this scale, this uplift could materially increase GFA and overall project returns. Prospective purchasers are encouraged to seek independent planning advice on the applicability and pathway for this mechanism on the subject site.

Proposed Development Scheme

Indicative Boutique Apartment Scheme

The natural topography of the site lends itself to a tiered residential flat building design, maximising the harbour view corridor while integrating efficiently with the existing streetscape on both Woodland Street and Nield Avenue.

An indicative scheme of approximately 12 apartments across multiple levels is achievable, comprising:

  • Ground / lower level: Garden apartments with private courtyards
  • Upper levels: Harbour view apartments toward Sydney Harbour
  • Basement: Efficient parking accessed via Woodland Street
  • Connecting structure: Modelled basement driveway linking both lots

Purchasing the raw landholding — rather than proceeding with the lodged 5-unit scheme on 2 Nield Avenue — enables a developer to maximise GFA across the full combined 1,934m² and unlock the full potential of the LMR controls.

5-Unit Compliant Scheme (2 Nield Ave)
The vendor is currently progressing a compliant 5-unit scheme on the Nield Avenue lot, with a DA submission targeted for May 2026. Plans are available via the data room for review. This scheme demonstrates regulatory compliance and provides a baseline development approval pathway.

Raw Site — Recommended Approach

Acquiring the full 1,934m² as a raw site enables a developer to design-optimise across both lots, maximise NSA, and access Affordable Housing uplift provisions — delivering a materially superior outcome to any split or staged approach.

Market Evidence

Comparable Sales Analysis

The following comparable transactions provide context for both end-product pricing and current land values in the Balgowlah development market.

End Product — Apartment Sales

The following transactions establish the resale rate benchmarks for quality apartment product in Balgowlah. Notably, all four comparables are burdened by one or more value detractors — age, busy road position, high strata levies, or limited outlook — that a new boutique development on Woodland Street would not share. The clear market read is that well-located, new-build product with genuine harbour views in a quiet, leafy setting commands a material premium, underpinning the projected $35,000+/m² rate for this project.

Location & Amenity

Balgowlah, Northern Beaches

Balgowlah is a well-established, tightly-held suburb on Sydney's Northern Beaches, offering a premium blend of lifestyle amenity, transport connectivity, and neighbourhood character that consistently underpins strong demand from both owner-occupiers and investors.

The subject site occupies an elevated, quiet residential position within walking distance of Balgowlah's village retail and café precinct, North Harbour Reserve, and regular bus services to the CBD and Manly — a combination that is rarely replicated in a boutique development context on the Northern Beaches.

The harbour outlook from the upper levels captures North Harbour and extends toward Sydney Harbour — views of this calibre represent a genuine scarcity premium at the completion and sale stage.
